emp_source: Form 5500 participants for EIN 208826851 (sponsor HOMAGE, LLC): 76 in 2019, 132 in 2023
notes: Express, Inc.'s 2017 10-Q describes a $10.6 million non-controlling stake in Homage, LLC, a private retailer based in Columbus, so Express was not the parent. Homage's Form 5500 shows 76 plan participants in 2019, and its holding company files only Form D with the SEC.

Persistent Systems Inc. of Santa Clara is the US arm of Pune-based IT services firm Persistent Systems Limited, which Wikipedia lists at 23,941 employees in 2024; its US plan alone had 513 Form 5500 participants in 2015. The 2017 group headcount was not fetched, but a company of that scale was very likely over 5,000 then too.

JobsOhio's release (https://www.jobsohio.com/newsroom/news-press/chillicothe-kenworth-announces-expansion-new-jobs-in-ross-county) says Chillicothe Kenworth is MHC RoadReady Center, part of MHC, with 76 jobs retained; MHC's site says it has nearly 5,000 employees today, so the 2019 figure was likely under 5,000. MHC was founded in Springfield, Missouri, and is based in Leawood, Kansas.
